evidence.name: Screen field: Where the image sits
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Where the image sits" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Where the image sits
sections.description: On headline screens, this sets where the hero image sits relative to your title and subtitle — above the text, below it, or beside it. Lead with your strongest element: image-on-top when the visual is the hook, text-on-top when the headline does the selling. The preview updates instantly, so try a couple and keep whichever reads clearest.
